title: The Selection
author: Kiera Cass
summary: Thirty-five girls from across a divided kingdom are chosen to compete for the hand of the crown prince. America Singer enters only to please her family, and she already has a secret boyfriend back home.
readIf: you want a quick, glossy, romantic competition story with dresses, palace rivalry and a love triangle.
skipIf: you want sophisticated politics or dislike love triangles.

pairings.reason: Another fairy-tale-flavoured YA with a prince, but with more science fiction and plot.
A darker YA that also puts a young woman in a palace full of danger and royal choices.
